== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ベン翁</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">君のキャラクターのどれか（除くオビ＝ワン）がタトゥイーン位置カードから没収された際、1フォース消費すれば、謎の“狂える魔術師”が立ち寄って復活させてくれる。フォースを消費せずに、同じ場所に再配備すること。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「あの老いぼれは、気のふれた魔術師にすぎぬ」オビ＝ワンは何年もの間、タトゥイーンの砂漠で生活していた……来るべき時のために。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Old Ben]].

'''Lore''' — “That old man is nothing but a crazy wizard.” Obi-Wan lived in Tatooine's deserts for years… for the time that must come.

'''Game text''' — If one of your characters (except Obi-Wan) is forfeited from a Tatooine location card, use 1 Force. A mysterious “crazy wizard” steps in and revives that character. Re-deploy to the same place without using Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore ends 来るべき時のために rather than ready for the right moment to act. Game text uses 位置カード and 同じ場所 rather than Tatooine site and same site.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-oldben-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Old Ben]].</ref>
